description: pyproject.toml [project].version is the single source of truth for the package version, and [project].name is the distribution name (tether-it). tether/__init__.py derives __version__ via importlib.metadata.version('tether-it') — the argument must equal [project].name — and cli.py surfaces it as 'tether --version'. Renaming the distribution in pyproject.toml requires updating the version('...') argument in __init__.py to match, or the package fails to import with PackageNotFoundError. Bump the version in pyproject.toml only. Note evals/margin/scripts/run-smoke.sh stamps the wheel by sed-ing pyproject.toml's literal version line, so that line must stay a static literal (not PEP 621 dynamic).
